ops.text: Follow-up confirming the homeguard/catalog papercut: the live-daemon theory is now measured, not inferred. With no test process running at all, ~/.cc-notes/fusekit-v1/catalog.sqlite-wal mtime advanced across a 100s idle window (1788962501 -> 1788962621) while an earlier 20s window was quiet. So the CCNotesHelper daemon rewrites its own catalog on a periodic tick of roughly a minute, and any homeguard-guarded package whose tests run longer than that tick will FAIL after PASSing, on any machine with the helper installed and running, regardless of what the suite does. The suite cannot influence these files and no test asserts on them.
